attchmntText: Jupiter Wagons Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Jupiter Wagons Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through a Qualified Institutions Placement on 4th December 2023 for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The net proceeds were Rs. 394.18 Crores. The monitoring agency is Care Ratings Limited. There was no deviation or variation in the use of funds during the quarter. The original object of setting up a new captive alloy steel foundry unit at Jabalpur was modified pursuant to shareholder approval dated 18th April 2025. The unutilized funds are to be used for enhancing foundry capacity at the Bandel unit. Shareholder approval for this modification was obtained on 29th September 2026. The allocation for this purpose was Rs. 50.00 Crores, with Rs. 6.36 Crores utilized. The remaining allocation for working capital requirements was Rs. 215.00 Crores, fully utilized. The allocation for inorganic growth and general corporate purposes was Rs. 129.18 Crores, fully utilized. No comments were received from the audit committee or auditors.

voiceSummary: Jupiter Wagons Limited filed an investor presentation regarding results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at Rs. 772 Crore, up 15% quarter on quarter. EBITDA was Rs. 94 Crore, up 45% quarter on quarter, with a margin of 12.2%. Profit after tax was Rs. 46 Crore, with earnings per share at Rs. 1.12. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was Rs. 1,443 Crore, up 16% year on year. EBITDA was Rs. 159 Crore with a margin of 11%. Profit after tax was Rs. 72 Crore, with earnings per share at Rs. 1.78. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report(s) for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jupiter Wagons Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding its Qualified Institutional Placement of equity shares. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. The total issue size was Rs. 403.41 crore. The monitoring agency reported no deviation from the objects of the issue. The cost of objects was revised following shareholder approval dated September 29, 2026. The revised cost for enhancing capacity at the Bandel foundry is Rs. 6.36 crore, which has been fully utilized. The revised cost for working capital requirements is Rs. 258.64 crore, with Rs. 43.64 crore remaining unutilized. No utilization occurred during the quarter for working capital. The amount for inorganic growth and general corporate purposes, Rs. 129.18 crore, is fully utilized. The company is utilizing unutilized proceeds through SBI Mutual Fund.

attchmntText: Jupiter Wagons Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the outcome of the Board Meeting  dated 13th November, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jupiter Wagons Limited Board of Directors approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30 September 2026 on 13 November 2026. The Board took on record the Auditors Report. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year ended 30 September 2026 was Rs. 1,29,158.32 Lakhs. Profit before tax for the same period was Rs. 24,597.76 Lakhs. Profit for the period was Rs. 18,250.32 Lakhs. Basic Earnings Per Share was Rs. 4.29. Standalone total assets as at 30 September 2026 were Rs. 4,20,290.80 Lakhs. The meeting commenced at 12:30 P.M. and concluded at 04:10 P.M. The financial results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Jupiter Wagons Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Jupiter Wagons Limited will hold an audio conference call with analysts and investors on Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. The meeting is scheduled to discuss financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The event is classified as a Group Meet for Q2 and HY1FY27. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Details are available on the company website at https://jupiterwagons.com/investors/. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Ritesh Kumar Singh on November 11, 2026.
